title: The WhatsApp way
caption: At closing time Ravi is tired. He sends three numbers on WhatsApp, and his day is recorded.
linkedin_text: A shopkeeper at closing time does not want another form. He sends three numbers in one WhatsApp message: sales, expenses and cash. ScoreMyBiz records them. In the free month a photo of the notebook or a voice note works too, and nothing is saved until he says YES.

cast.ravi: Ravi, a young Indian mobile-phone shop owner with a trimmed beard in a checked shirt and a lanyard

scenes.clip: the founder, a young Indian man with a short beard in a navy suit and striped tie, facing the camera in a busy market lane at night, shop signs glowing behind him, a warm smile.
scenes.vo: Hi. This is Ravi's story. He sells mobile phones, and at closing time he is tired.

scenes.clip: {ravi} gently closing the glass door of his phone shop in the evening, shop lights glowing behind him, a thoughtful expression.
scenes.vo: The day's sales, expenses and cash are still in his head. He does not want to fill in another form tonight.
scenes.sub: The day's sales, expenses and cash are still in his head. He does not want to fill in another form tonight.

scenes.clip: {ravi} sitting on a stool outside his shop typing on his phone, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: So he opens WhatsApp, and sends ScoreMyBiz three numbers in one message: sales, expenses and cash.
scenes.sub: So he opens WhatsApp, and sends ScoreMyBiz three numbers in one message: sales, expenses and cash.

scenes.clip: {ravi} reading his phone with a relieved smile, shop lights behind him, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
scenes.vo: The reply says Recorded. His day is in his book.

scenes.clip: {ravi} speaking into his phone at the shop counter, an open notebook beside him, the subject on the left of the frame, the right third of the frame kept clear.
